question: What support can I get for studying a qualification?
expected_answer: Course fees up to £1,000 a year and up to 5 days' paid study leave, after probation.
ai_answer: Employees who have passed probation can apply through LearnHub for study support for a qualification relevant to their role. This covers course fees of up to £1,000 per year and up to 5 days of paid study leave per year for exams and study. Applications must be approved by the line manager and the Head of Learning and Development. If you leave within 12 months of the course finishing you must repay 100% of the course fees, and if you leave between 12 and 24 months after it finishes you must repay 50%. Travel and accommodation for approved training are claimed under the Expenses Policy, and course fees must not be claimed as expenses.

question: If I leave 18 months after the company paid for my course, do I have to pay anything back?

ai_answer: Yes. Under the Training and Development Policy, if you leave between 12 and 24 months after your course finishes, you must repay 50% of the course fees. The 12-24 month period is counted from when the course finishes, not from when the company paid the fees, so you should check your course end date. Passage P2 is cut off before it states the repayment percentage for this period, so the 50% figure comes from P1 alone.

question: Can I roll over unused holiday into next year?
expected_answer: Yes, up to 8 days, which must be used by 30 June.
ai_answer: Yes, up to 8 days of unused annual leave can be carried forward into the next leave year without needing approval, and they must be used by 30 June of the new leave year. Any carried-forward days not used by 30 June are lost and are not paid. Exceptions exist: where an employee has written approval from the company, up to 20 days may be carried forward; days carried forward because of sickness must be used within 18 months of the end of the leave year in which they were earned, and other exceptional carry-forward must be used by 30 June. question: Where do I report a customer I think is laundering money?
